title: C4OS Grill Question 029 - Remove Project Semantics

questions.label: What should Remove Project do?
questions.help: Recommended: remove the project from the workspace/project registry and delete its C4OS chat/session history, but never delete filesystem files. This matches your original 'do not retain history' requirement.
options: Remove registry entry and C4OS history; never delete filesystem files
Remove from current workspace only; preserve project chat history
Offer optional filesystem deletion after confirmation
Archive project history instead of deleting it

questions.label: What should Remove Chat do?
questions.help: Recommended: confirm, then permanently remove the chat and its C4OS-owned history/attachments, without retaining hidden history.
options: Confirm, then permanently remove chat and C4OS-owned history
Archive chat so it can be restored later
Remove from list but keep history in storage

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify behavior for shared project chats across workspace files, missing projects, attachments, artifacts, Browser state, Terminal state, or audit logs.
